gap_classification.notes: Site is live (WordPress, HTTP 200) with /fixed-deposit/, /deposits/ and /interest-rates/ pages. However /interest-rates/ only describes LOAN products ('affordable interest rates on Home/Mortgage/business/agri loans...') and /fixed-deposit/ describes the FD product features but neither shows a deposit rate table. No rate-card image or deposit-rate PDF among uploads (only forms, annual reports, KYC docs). Bank publishes no FD interest-rate schedule online; directs customers to nearest branch.
